procedure: Prerequisites: every required_gap_id must be resolved with evidence. Before the first and each subsequent Flicker Strike use, establish Hit and Run activation. If teleport does not re-enable it, account for an evidenced movement action and its elapsed time, or stop with a blocking gap. Unassigned secondary damage cannot enter D(c) or the score; attribution must be accepted before computation.
1. t = 0: 0 Power Charges, 0 Combo, persistent Spirit skills active (owner Q4), energy shield and mana full.

2. Cycle k = 1, 2, ...: one Whirling Assault use lasting t_WA, then one Flicker Strike use (owner Q1, Q2). Charged Staff's place is gap-p09-t011-rotation-details; no value is computed until it closes.

3. At Whirling Assault use k, Combo K_k = min(K_max, Combo gained since the previous Whirling Assault use, per g). It is expended; the Power Charges gained follow Ailith's Chimes, expected p x K_k, with the distribution the Surpassing rule gives (gap-p09-t011-charge-cycle-rules). Charges held C_k = min(C_max, carried_k + gained_k). Flicker Strike's 'cannot gain Power Charges while using this Skill' means no charge is gained during step 4.

4. Flicker Strike use k performs H(C_k) strikes, each lasting 1 / S_F(C_k) (gap-p09-t011-flicker-strike-timing). D(C_k) is credited in equal parts D(C_k) / H(C_k) at each strike's end. Over a charge distribution, use E[D] = sum over c of P(C_k = c) x D(c); never interpolate D between charge counts.
5. Charges carried into cycle k + 1: each consumed charge is kept with probability q (Perpetual Charge), capped at C_max.

6. flicker_sustained_dps = credited damage whose strike ends in [0, 120) divided by 120. flicker_burst_dps = credited damage whose strike ends in [0, 5) divided by 5, from the same t = 0 state. Only completed strikes count at a window end.

7. Report mana: m_WA per Whirling Assault use and m_F per Flicker Strike use against maximum mana and regeneration; flask use is gap-p09-t011-sustain-cycle. Report whether the cycle reaches a repeating charge state (D07 item 6).
8. Whirling Assault's own damage and every other skill's damage are reported separately and never enter the score (D07 item 3).
value.community_method_difference: The community reference (poe.ninja 25c49) reads AverageBurstDamage at forced charges (7, above its maximum of 6) with forced Combo, Rage, Onslaught and enemy conditions: burst per use, no charge generation time. pob-cycle-v1 uses the same PoB outputs but only charges the rotation generates, and divides by elapsed time including each Whirling Assault use. PoB TotalDPS (AverageDamage x Speed) also ignores charge generation time.

derived_from_evidence.claim: Whirling Assault in the seed carries Culmination II and Ailith's Chimes (skill group 8).
Culmination II adds ComboStacking, holds up to 10 Combo gained from strikes with other melee attacks, expends all Combo on use, decay delay 6000 ms.
Ailith's Chimes requires ComboStacking and gives a 25% Surpassing chance per Combo expended to gain a Power Charge. This is the seed's only cited Power Charge source.
Seed ascendancy: Martial Adept (additional Combo when gaining Combo) and Martial Master (Combo from all Attack Hits) are allocated.
Maximum Power Charges 5: base 3 plus Overflowing Power +2, matching the owner's 5.

Flicker Strike consumes Power Charges for 2 additional teleporting strikes per charge and cannot gain Power Charges while used. PoB models the extra strikes as 2 x removable Power Charges (AverageBurstHits 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 at 0 to 5 charges).
Perpetual Charge on Flicker Strike: 25% chance to not remove Charges but still count as consuming them.
Hit and Run on Flicker Strike: usable after moving 10 metres, unusable again after use, 40% more skill speed.
Charged Staff consumes all Power Charges and requires 1; in PoB its per-charge buff reads the same charges Flicker Strike's strikes do.
Mana: Flicker Strike 85 base cost at gem level 20; PoB shows 248 per use, Whirling Assault 160, against 887 maximum mana (proxy_only).

data_gaps.explanation: pob-cycle-v1 needs the Combo Whirling Assault holds at each use. Catalog text gives the parts, not the game semantics: whether Flicker Strike strikes are 'other Melee Attacks' that grant Combo to the Culmination-supported Whirling Assault, how many per strike with Martial Adept (one extra per gain) and Martial Master (Combo from all Attack Hits), whether Whirling Assault's own hits grant it Combo, whether the 10 Combo cap applies before or after Martial Adept's extra, what distribution '25% Surpassing chance per Combo expended' gives, and how Perpetual Charge's kept charges carry into the next cycle.
data_gaps.needed_evidence: For each question, evidence: an official statement, a catalog or engine implementation that settles it, or a recording with the Combo and Power Charge counters legible over at least 20 cycles.
data_gaps.collection_method: Engine or catalog lookup first; recordings as optional validation; a reviewer accepts each rule before any pob-cycle-v1 value is computed. P09-T01.2 settled the Surpassing distribution and Perpetual Charge's per-charge rule, and left Combo per strike and Whirling Assault's own Combo open with both alternatives and their conflict with the owner's '5 power charges' written out (docs/evidence/P09-T01.2/mechanics-rules.json).

data_gaps.explanation: PoB applies Charged Staff's per-charge added lightning and Flicker Strike's per-charge strikes from the same RemovablePowerCharges: with Charged Staff enabled, per-strike AverageDamage is 136232 at 5 forced charges, with it disabled 124231. Both skills consume all Power Charges, so in game the same charges cannot feed both on one use.
data_gaps.needed_evidence: Which D(c) table pob-cycle-v1 uses: Charged Staff buff stacks from charges actually consumed by Charged Staff under the rotation (needs Q10), or Charged Staff disabled.
data_gaps.collection_method: Owner answer to Q10 (once per N cycles) and N, then a reviewer rule. P09-T01.2 proposes buff stacks from the charges Charged Staff consumed, captures A_CS(s) and the no-buff values on the benchmark document, and states the open refresh rule (docs/evidence/P09-T01.2/mechanics-rules.json charged-staff-buff-ownership).

data_gaps.explanation: pob-cycle-v1 times every Flicker Strike strike, including the extra teleporting strikes, at 1 / PoB Speed, with no travel or Hit and Run movement time. PoB's TotalDPS makes the same assumption for a single strike. Not validated.
data_gaps.needed_evidence: Recorded duration of Flicker Strike uses at known charge counts, or an engine or official statement of the extra strikes' timing.
data_gaps.collection_method: Optional owner recording of Flicker Strike uses at 1 and 5 charges, read frame by frame.

data_gaps.explanation: Hit and Run makes Flicker Strike usable after moving 10 metres. Owner Q5: 'the dash from flicker itself' supplies it. The catalog does not confirm that Flicker Strike's teleport counts as moving.
data_gaps.needed_evidence: Engine, official or recorded evidence that Flicker Strike's teleport re-enables Hit and Run, including the first-use activation condition; otherwise a legal movement action with its time charged to the cycle, or a supported replacement setup.
data_gaps.collection_method: Engine or official rule lookup; a recording of consecutive uses is an optional evidence route, not a waiver of activation. P09-T01.2 found no pinned or retrieved evidence either way and wrote three labelled variants: teleport re-enables (owner Q5), no Hit and Run (S_F 6.6588 captured), and a timed 10 m movement (needs movement speed in metres per second) (docs/evidence/P09-T01.2/mechanics-rules.json).

data_gaps.explanation: D07 item 6 needs resource depletion and whether the cycle repeats. PoB: Flicker Strike 248 mana per use, Whirling Assault 160, 887 maximum mana, 47.9 mana regeneration per second. Owner Q6: mana flask used on bosses; mana on kill does nothing there. Flask recovery and charge gain are not in the method yet.
data_gaps.needed_evidence: PoB's mana flask recovery and charge gain for the seed's flask, or a reviewer rule for flask use in the 120 s window.
data_gaps.collection_method: P09-T01.2 captured the mana flask from PoB (356.5 mana per use, 10 of 75 charges, 0.25 charges per second, no kill charges on the benchmark). Still open: flask charges at t = 0, when the flask is used, and per-use versus per-strike Flicker Strike mana (gap-p09-t012-flicker-mana-charging); reviewer rule.

data_gaps.explanation: D07 forbids free maximum-state toggles. The seed's imported PoB config carries condition inputs (for example conditionChampionIntimidate, inDemonForm, touchedDebuffsCount 10, purpleFlameStacks 10, targetBrandedEnemy, SecondsSinceInevitableCrit 10, multiplierCurrentManaPercentage 100) whose effect on Flicker Strike and whose sustain under the rotation are not checked.
data_gaps.needed_evidence: For each condition input that changes a Flicker Strike output: evidence the build sustains it under the rotation, or the input switched off in the benchmark configuration.
data_gaps.collection_method: PoB comparison with each input toggled; reviewer rule. P09-T01.2 swept every socket group and listed every Config-sourced, conditional and enemy modifier: one forced state found (Pounce's Predator's Mark, 24% increased damage taken from eight Living Lightning minions), switched off in the benchmark documents; no imported config input feeds a Flicker Strike modifier (docs/evidence/P09-T01.2/mechanics-rules.json pounce-predators-mark, pob-default-states). Awaiting reviewer acceptance.

data_gaps.explanation: The catalog verdict is partial: the engine data release predates 0.5.5e and slot-accepted-base-categories is open (P02-T02.1).
data_gaps.needed_evidence: An accepted patch profile with compatibility verified for 0.5.5e or the patch the measurements are taken on.

data_gaps.explanation: With PoB as the damage source, benchmark numbers must come from a clean checkout of the pin. The seed's stats and the charge table came from the operator's checkout at the pinned HEAD with an unchecked working tree.
data_gaps.needed_evidence: The charge table and Whirling Assault outputs recomputed from the stored export in a clean checkout of ce566ea.
data_gaps.collection_method: Load docs/evidence/P09-T01.1/seed/export-flicker-main.xml in a clean pinned engine and repeat the pob-charge-table.json procedure. Done by scripts/p09_t01_2_seed_replay.py: all 734 imported outputs, the charge table, Whirling Assault and the enemy agree exactly on a clean checkout of the pin.

data_gaps.explanation: Only the combo-expenditure variant has an export. Each approved variant needs complete configurations.

data_gaps.explanation: Owner Q10: Charged Staff is pressed once per N Whirling Assault to Flicker Strike cycles to refresh its buff. N decides how many charges Charged Staff takes from Flicker Strike, how much of the window its buff covers, and its time and mana.
data_gaps.needed_evidence: The number N, and the press's position inside its cycle.
data_gaps.collection_method: Owner answer relayed by the coordinator; a reviewer records it in the rotation.

data_gaps.explanation: Flicker Strike costs 248 mana in PoB. Its text describes one use with additional teleporting strikes (one payment), while PoB's ManaPerSecondCost multiplies the cost by the strike rate (one payment per strike). At 5 charges the two differ elevenfold.
data_gaps.needed_evidence: An official statement, a pinned engine rule, or a recording of the mana globe across Flicker Strike uses at known charges.
data_gaps.collection_method: Engine or official lookup; optional owner recording read frame by frame.

data_gaps.explanation: The class list and variants were proposals; D07 makes scope the owner's decision.
data_gaps.needed_evidence: The owner's approved ascendancy list and variants.
data_gaps.collection_method: Owner answer to Q9: 'any class, any ascendancy, any variant'.

data_gaps.explanation: The seed runs Chaos Inoculation (maximum life 1), so its survivable pool is energy shield. Any margin stricter than deaths equal zero would be a fitted threshold.
data_gaps.needed_evidence: A minimum energy shield fraction per encounter, set from recorded incoming damage, or an explicit decision to keep deaths equal zero as the only gate.
data_gaps.collection_method: Reviewer decision after gap-p09-t011-incoming-damage has data.
